pick.headline: Martial law declared in Beijing
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of May 23, 1989, carried Moscow TASS in English from Beijing: troops called to enforce martial law stayed outside the city, behind barricades, while about a million people gathered at Tiananmen.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 098, 23 May 1989
evidence.snippet: …GMT 23 May 89 [Text] Beijing May 23 TASS—By TASS correspondents Marat Abulkhatin, Gennadiy Krivosheyev and Oleg Mastryukov: Beijing was calm overnight. Troops from among the Beijing Military District, called to maintain martial law and stationed in rural areas around the capital, did not attempt to enter the city. Numerous barricades, made up of lorries, buses, rein- forced concrete pipes, and other building materials were set up in the evening on…
